responsibility: Declares the vis-item visitor used to compute privacy reachability in the Rust frontend. It defines the ReachabilityVisitor API, including helpers for deriving reachability from HIR::Visibility and for marking generic predicates reachable using TypeCheckContext, and provides the class interface that updates PrivacyContext while traversing modules and other visible items.
same_name_distinction: This is the declaration half of the reachability pair: unlike rust-reachability.cc, it defines the ReachabilityVisitor interface and helper APIs but not the concrete propagation rules that mark items reachable.
